snippet.title: Forgive Me Father 2 | Consoles Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Forgive Me Father 2 is coming to Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 this September 23, with the Nintendo Switch version to follow later!

Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares to restore your sanity. Blast your way through hordes of possessed enemies, unlock an arsenal of deadly weapons and get ready to face even more Lovecraftian madness in this action-packed FPS sequel.

Wishlist now on consoles:
Playstation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014515 
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/forgive-me-father-2/9mx24tvw0pwq

Available Now on PC:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/forgive-me-father-2-ea03a5
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/forgive_me_father_2
